about: PTA Online's jobs (ONLINE_MODE.md 5, scripts/online/bus_job.gd): what they pay, in euros. Only the official server's copy counts. hour_cap: what an account may earn from all jobs in an hour (the accounts service cuts the rest).

bus.about: Paid at each stop served (in the bay, under 1 m/s, doors open `doors` s): stop + per_km of route driven since the last stop; fast: + fast_share of that when the stretch took at most fast_ratio times the bots' planned driving time; the stretch's bonuses added; all of it times the combo (combo_step more per stop served, up to combo_max, back to 1 at a penalty), times owned for the player's own bus, times 1 + rider per player riding (riders_max at most). Penalties are taken from the next pay.
